reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: In src/signal.rs, the module owns sigs and registers image-lifetime handler code; handlers borrow screen/filter/command state owned elsewhere rather than acquiring independent snapshots.
owner_creation.invariant: Registered code lifetime is separate from application state.

aliases_escapes.analysis: In src/signal.rs, u_interrupt may retire filter aliases, sigusr1 borrows configuration text then mutates the command queue, and terminate can free owners active on interrupted stacks.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A handler cannot assume interrupted owner borrows ended.

callback_targets.analysis: In src/signal.rs, init_signals names u_interrupt, stop, lwinch, terminate, sigalarm and sigusr1; ignored/default/error values still cross Option function-pointer representations.
callback_targets.invariant: Signal sentinels are not ordinary Rust function targets.

invalidation.analysis: In src/signal.rs, handoff replaces dispositions but active handler work can already have changed filters or queue state; there is no typed retirement token for the registered application context.
invalidation.invariant: Disposition replacement does not restore retired data aliases.

mutation_commit.analysis: In src/signal.rs, sigs uses read/modify/write and psignals snapshots then clears it; some resize work is deferred, while direct filter/queue/quit effects remain outside that commit.
mutation_commit.invariant: Notification bits do not make handler effects transactional.

release_pair.analysis: In src/signal.rs, set_filter_pattern and quit invoke external owner release; the handlers have no local owning value whose Drop can coordinate those interrupted resources.
release_pair.invariant: Async release must not invalidate suspended ordinary callers.

error_cleanup.analysis: In src/signal.rs, registration results are mostly ignored and sentinels are transmuted; fatal handler cleanup can enter an already partial application transaction.
error_cleanup.invariant: Signal error paths lack an independently validated owner state.

signals_handoff.analysis: In src/signal.rs, the four maintained M0-SIG findings describe the direct filter mutation, async lookup/queue work, termination cleanup and sentinel representation still left open.
signals_handoff.invariant: Handler review records hazards rather than approving safety.
limitations: This file review reuses current source facts, not a new job-control or signal campaign; no M0-SIG finding is resolved.
